proposed_donor.language: Persian-origin regional loan; immediate donor unresolved

proposals.evidence: Perder Table39 gives taŋ with the light verb kur do, forming trouble. Platts marks tang as Persian and explicitly lists the troubled/vexed sense and tang karnā distress/harass, a closer comparison than the physical narrow sense alone. This supports a probable regional loan used in a light-verb construction; it does not establish the immediate donor language or transfer the entire donor polysemy into Dameli. Preserve the source gloss trouble and do not confuse the retroflex ṭaŋg drumbeat.
